detailed_description: This workflow takes a research paper PDF and automatically generates a visual layout reference for academic conference posters. The output shows how the poster could be structured — including column arrangement, color palette, section hierarchy, and typography — and serves as a starting point for your own design. Note that the generated image is for layout inspiration only; specific numbers, method names, and other paper content may not be fully accurate and should always be verified against the original paper before use.
